gbm_population_evidence.quote: Subject has a histologically confirmed (frozen section) diagnosis of recurrent WHO Grade IV glioblastoma multiforme (GBM).
Laparoscopically Harvested Omental Free Tissue Autograft to Bypass the Blood Brain Barrier (BBB) in Human Recurrent Glioblastoma Multiforme (rGBM)

candidate_evidence.quote: Laparoscopically harvested omental free flap into the resection cavity of recurrent glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) patients.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: All participants included in the study will undergo standard surgical resection for diagnosed recurrent GBM.

coder_notes: Surgical procedure only (omental free flap autograft lining the resection cavity); no drug or biologic intervention registered. Conditions also list glioma/malignant glioma, but inclusion requires recurrent WHO grade IV glioblastoma multiforme, so gbm_only; 'glioblastoma multiforme' gives historical terminology.
